name: Potion

name: Immunizer

name: Hot Drink

name: Monster Broth

name: Ancient Potion

description: Enhances the effects of\nother materials, but cannot\nbe used on its own.

name: Energy Drink
description: A Guild-approved beverage\nthat boosts Stamina. Helps\nshake off Sleep too!

description: ダミー。

name: Gunpowder
description: A volatile substance that\nexplodes when struck or\nheated.

name: Lifecrystals
description: Mysterious crystals long\nworshipped as a source of\nlife.

name: Lifepowder
description: Medicine made of compounded\nLifecrystals. Heals those\nnearby with a single touch.

name: Powercharm
description: An amulet that raises your\nAttack. Just carrying it\ngives you demonic strength.

name: Powertalon
description: A powerful amulet that\nraises Attack. Made with\na Lao-Shan Claw.

name: Armorcharm
description: An amulet that raises your\nDefense. Just carrying this\nhardens your skin.

name: Armortalon
description: A powerful amulet that\nraises Defense. Made with\na Lao-Shan Claw.

name: Tranquilizer
description: Medicine that works as an\nanesthetic when combined.

name: Raw Meat
description: Meat carved from a monster.\nCan be cooked, combined, or\nused to set a trap.

name: Oiled Meat
description: Raw meat basted with a\nfragrant oil that'll make\nanyone's mouth water.

name: Spiced Meat
description: Raw meat basted with a\nspicy rub that'll make\nanyone's mouth water.

name: Glazed Meat
description: Raw meat basted with a\nrefreshing, yet sweet glaze.\nMakes anyone's mouth water.

name: Poisoned Meat
description: Raw meat that poisons\nanything that eats it.\nGreat bait for traps.

name: Tinged Meat
description: Raw meat that paralyzes\nanything that eats it.\nGreat bait for traps.

name: Drugged Meat
description: Raw meat that causes sleep\nin anything that eats it.\nGreat bait for traps.

name: Rare Steak
description: Provides a small boost to\nyour stamina. This one's\nstill red in the middle.

name: Well-done Steak
description: Provides a moderate boost \nto your stamina. Packed\nwith juicy goodness.

name: Gourmet Steak
description: The pinnacle of steaks.\nSo juicy and crisp it'll\nboost your full Stamina.

name: Burnt Meat
description: Meat that has been burnt to\na crisp. It might boost your\nStamina, or it might not...

name: Hot Meat
description: Meat that warms the body\nand provides temporary\nrelief from extreme cold.

name: Hot Meat+
description: Provides temporary relief\nfrom the cold and restores\na small amount of Stamina.

name: Chilled Meat
description: Meat that cools the body\nand provides temporary\nrelief from extreme heat.

name: Chilled Meat+
description: Provides temporary relief\nfrom the heat and restores\na small amount of Stamina.

name: Antidote Meat
description: Antidotal meat that removes\nPoison from your system.

name: Antidote Meat+
description: Antidotal meat that removes\nPoison from your system and\nrecovers some Stamina.

name: Rare Fish
description: While not fully cooked, it\nwill still restore Stamina.

name: Well-done Fish
description: A crispy grilled fish that\nimproves natural healing\nand restores Stamina.

name: Well-done Fish+
description: High-quality grilled fish.\nBoosts natural recovery and \nStamina.

name: Gourmet Fish
description: Fish grilled to perfection.\nBoosts natural recovery and\nStamina.

name: Gourmet Fish+
description: A large fish grilled to\nperfection. Boosts natural\nrecovery and Stamina.

name: Burnt Fish
description: Charred fish. Eating it will\nstill recover some Stamina.

description: ダミー。

name: Boomerang
description: An unusually-shaped weapon\nfrom abroad that returns to\nits user when thrown.

name: Throwing Knife
description: A standard throwing knife.\nFlies straight and true.\n~C05(Supply Item)~C00

name: Poison Knife
description: A throwing knife with a\nvenom-coated blade. Poisons\ntargets. ~C05(Supply Item)~C00

name: Sleep Knife
description: A throwing knife that has\nbeen dusted with sleeping\nagents. ~C05(Supply Item)~C00

name: Paralysis Knife
description: A throwing knife coated\nwith toxins that paralyze\na target. ~C05(Supply Item)~C00

name: Tranq Knife
description: A throwing knife used to\ncapture monsters ensnared\nin traps. ~C05(Supply Item)~C00

name: Bomb Casing
description: A base material for making\nhand-thrown bombs.

name: Paintball
description: Toss this scented paint at a \nmonster to mark it, allowing\nyou to track its position.

name: Flash Bomb
description: Flashes brightly on impact.\nToss this right under a\nmonster's nose to blind it.

name: Sonic Bomb
description: A grenade-like item that\nemits a high-frequency blast\nof sound on detonation.

name: Dung
description: That's right: monster poop.\nThe odor reveals (too) much\nabout a monster's diet.

name: Dung Bomb
description: When thrown, releases a\nstrong odor which certain\nmonsters find repulsive.

name: Smoke Bomb
description: Creates a large cloud of\nsmoke wherever it lands.

name: Psn Smoke Bomb
description: Contains a toxic chemical.\nAlso popular as a household\nbug bomb.

name: Farcaster
description: Instantly transports you\nback to base camp.

name: Deodorant
description: An item that cures Stench.\nReleases deodorizing smoke\nwhen thrown down.

name: Tranq Bomb
description: A hand-thrown bomb used to\ncapture monsters ensnared in\ntraps.

name: Spider Web
description: A very sticky web.

name: Net
description: A sturdy net able to support\na certain amount of weight\nwithout breaking.

name: Trap Tool
description: A must-have item for putting\ntogether Pitfall Traps and\nother kinds of traps.

name: Pitfall Trap
description: A trap for catching certain\nlarge monsters. Tripped by\nheavy weight.

name: Shock Trap
description: A trap that immobilizes a\ntarget. Use it to capture\nmonsters.

name: Lightning Rod
description: A device used to attract\nlightning during storms.

description: A small barrel lid. There\nappears to be a drawing on\nit.

name: Small Barrel
description: A small, empty barrel.

name: Large Barrel
description: A large, empty barrel.

name: Barrel Bomb S
description: A small time-bomb.

name: Barrel Bomb S+
description: Upgraded Small Barrel Bomb.\nDespite its size, it packs\na strong punch.

name: Barrel Bomb L
description: Powerful bomb triggered by\nexternal, physical impact.

name: Barrel Bomb L+
description: Upgraded Large Barrel Bomb.\nEffective against large\nmonsters.

name: Bounce Bomb
description: Launches into the air when\nset. This modified bomb\nrequires skill to use.

name: Bounce Bomb+
description: An improved version of the\nBounce Bomb. Requires some\nskill to use.

name: Anti-Dragon Bomb
description: A small time bomb designed\nto stick directly to large\ntargets. ~C05(Supply Item)~C00

name: Event Bomb
description: 【ＣＴアイテム】\nイベント用爆弾

name: Huskberry
description: A berry that is hollow on\nthe inside. Tough enough to\ngrow just about anywhere.

name: Bone Husk S
description: Used as a bone ammo casing.\nProduces sturdier results\nthan a Huskberry.

name: Bone Husk L
description: Ammo casing made from large\nwyvern bones. Produces even\nsturdier results.

description: Non-specialized ammo. More\npowerful than Lv2.\nCapacity: 99

description: Armor-piercing ammo that\ndeals multiple hits to some\nmonsters. Capacity: 60

description: High-grade armor-piercing\nammo. Deals more hits than\nLv1. Capacity: 50

name: Pierce S Lv3
description: Max-grade armor-piercing\nammo. Deals numerous hits.\nCapacity: 40

description: Ammo that spreads out to\ncover a wide area.\nCapacity: 60

name: Pellet S Lv2
description: Ammo that covers a wide \narea. Deals more hits than\nLv1. Capacity: 60

name: Pellet S Lv3
description: Max-grade ammo that covers\na wide area. Deals numerous\nhits. Capacity: 60

description: Ammo that lodges in a target\nand explodes. Also deals\nStun. Capacity: 9

name: Crag S Lv2
description: Powerful ammo that lodges\nin a target and explodes.\nAlso stuns. Capacity: 9

name: Crag S Lv3
description: Devastating ammo that lodges\nin a target and explodes.\nAlso stuns. Capacity: 9

description: Ammo that divides into three\nshells upon impact. Beware\nfriendly fire! Capacity: 3

name: Clust S Lv2
description: Ammo that divides into four\nshells upon impact. Beware\nfriendly fire! Capacity: 3

name: Clust S Lv3
description: Ammo that divides into five\nshells upon impact. Beware\nfriendly fire! Capacity: 3

name: Water S

name: Thunder S
description: Ammo that packs an extra\npunch against enemies weak\nto Thunder. Capacity: 60

name: Freeze S
description: Ammo that packs an extra\npunch against enemies weak\nto Ice. Capacity: 60

name: Dragon S
description: Mysterious ammo that won't\nwork in normal Bowguns.\n Capacity: 20

description: Ammo that restores a small\namount of health to an ally\nupon impact. Capacity: 12

name: Recover S Lv2
description: Ammo that restores a medium\namount of health to an ally\nupon impact. Capacity: 12

description: Poisons target, but may\nrequire several shots.\nCapacity: 12

name: Poison S Lv2
description: Enhanced ammo that inflicts\nPoison. May require several\nshots. Capacity: 8

name: Para S Lv1
description: Paralyzes target, but may\nrequire several shots.\nCapacity: 12

name: Para S Lv2
description: Enhanced ammo that inflicts\nParalysis. May require \nseveral shots. Capacity: 8

name: Sleep S Lv1
description: Ammo that induces Sleep.\nSome targets may require\nmultiple shots. Capacity: 12

name: Sleep S Lv2
description: Enhanced ammo that inflicts\nSleep. May require several\nshots. Capacity: 8

name: Tranq S
description: Bowgun ammo used to capture\nmonsters ensnared in traps.  Capacity: 8

name: Paint S
description: Ammo that marks a monsters\nposition on the map for a\nlimited time. Capacity: 99

name: Demon S
description: Ammo that fills the target\nwith savage amounts of \nstrength. Capacity: 5

name: Armor S
description: Ammo that makes the targets\nskin as hard as stone.\nCapacity: 5

description: An energetic insect that is\npopular as fishing bait.

description: Often used as a fishing \nlure. Entices those fishies\nto bite.

description: A glowing insect that makes\nfor a great fishing lure.

description: Pickaxe tempered with steel.\nThis one won't nick easily.

description: A durable net for catching\nbugs.

description: An extremely durable net\nfor catching bugs. This\none is made to last.

description: Cooks faster than a normal\nBBQ Spit, but also requires\nmore skill to use.

description: A BBQ Spit tailored to the\ndiscerning male hunter.\nMakes grilling easy!

name: Ladies' BBQ Spit
description: A BBQ Spit tailored to the\ndiscerning female hunter.\nMakes grilling fun!

description: A BBQ Spit tailor-made for\nFelynes. You wouldn't blame\nthem for failing, would you?

description: An upgrade kit for a BBQ\nSpit. Combine them to take\nyour grilling to the max.

description: A versatile BBQ Spit lined\nwith Spiced Meat. All that's\nleft is to grill it!

name: Meat BBQ
description: A versatile BBQ Spit lined\nwith Glazed Meat. All that's\nleft is to grill it!

description: A versatile BBQ Spit lined\nwith Poisoned Meat. All that\nis left is to grill it!

name: Fish BBQ
description: A versatile BBQ Spit lined\nwith fish. All that's left\nis to grill it!

name: Fish BBQ
description: A versatile BBQ Spit lined\nwith a large fish. All that\nis left is to grill it!

description: A standard-sized Whetstone.\nUse it to restore a weapon's\nSharpness.

name: Binoculars
description: Allow you to see farther\nand observe from a distance.

name: Garbage
description: Junk created as a result of\na failed combination.

name: Field Horn
description: Used to attract monsters --\nblow at your own risk. May\nbreak when used.

name: Health Horn
description: A horn that restores Health\nto those who hear it. May\nbreak when used.

name: Antidote Horn
description: Eliminates poison in the\nblood of those who hear it.\nMay break when used.

name: Demon Horn
description: Increases the strength of\nthose who hear it. May break\nwhen used.

name: Armor Horn
description: Bolsters the defenses of\nthose who hear it. May break\nwhen used.

name: Honey
description: Sweet, golden honey. High in\nnutritional value.

name: Sunrise Herb
description: A curious herb that can be\npicked during the day. Used\nin combinations.

name: Sunset Herb
description: An aromatic herb that can\nonly be picked at night.\nUsed in combinations.

name: Herb
description: A plant that restores a very\nsmall amount of Health. Not\nvery flavorful.

name: Antidote Herb
description: A plant used in antidotes.\nIt sometimes cures poison\nwhen eaten by itself.

name: Fire Herb
description: A wondrous, flammable plant.

name: Ivy
description: A lightweight and extremely\nstrong plant.

name: Sleep Herb
description: A plant containing sleeping\nagents.

name: Sap Plant
description: A plant with leaves coated\nin sticky sap. Difficult to\nremove once attached.

name: Felvine
description: Melynxes' favorite food --\nthey just have to steal it.

name: Cactus Flower
description: Possesses antidotal agents,\nbut it will not work by\nitself.

name: Blooming Cactus
description: A mutated Cactus Flower.\nBlooms in odd places.\n~C05(Account Item)~C00

name: Hot Pepper
description: Blazingly spicy. It'll warm\nyou up, but it's too hot to\nhandle on its own.

name: Unique Mushroom
description: A pinky-sized mushroom with\nan unusual aroma. Beloved by\nMosswine. ~C05(Account Item)~C00

name: Choice Mushroom
description: The perfect shape and aroma.\nEven better than a Unique\nMushroom. ~C05(Account Item)~C00

name: Ripened Mushroom
description: A Unique Mushroom made more\nunique by maturing its aroma\nand flavor. ~C05(Account Item)~C00

name: Blue Mushroom
description: Rare mushroom with a power-\nenhancing effect.

name: Nitroshroom
description: A hard-to-find mushroom with\nthe power to generate strong\nheat.

name: Parashroom
description: A mushroom that induces\nparalysis.

name: Toadstool
description: Logic says not to eat this\npoisonous fungus, but don't\nwrite it off completely.

name: Exciteshroom
description: This one has a very strange\naroma... But is it edible?\nOnly one way to find out.

name: Mandragora
description: A dangerous fungus said to\ndraw the life out of people.\nBeware.

name: Spicy Mushroom
description: A mushroom that restores a\nsmall amount of Stamina.\n~C05(Account Item)~C00

name: Deadly Toadstool
description: A strange mushroom found\nonly at night. It can't be\neaten on its own.

name: Prism Dandelion
description: A pretty dandelion with\npetals of various colors.\nIt's used for making dyes.

name: Paintberry
description: A berry with a shocking hue\nand an overwhelming scent.\nLook out: it WILL stain!

name: Might Seed
description: Temporarily raises your\nAttack when ingested by\nimproving energy flow.

name: Adamant Seed
description: Temporarily raises your\nDefense when ingested by\nhardening tissue.

name: Dragonfell Berry
description: A mysterious berry, rumored\nsince ancient times to be\nloathed by dragons.

name: Scatternut
description: A nut that violently ejects\nits contents when struck.

name: Needleberry
description: A berry covered in needle-\nlike thorns. Used to craft\nammo.

name: Bomberry
description: A berry that explodes when\nstuck.

name: Broken Shell
description: A slightly damaged shell.

name: Black Pearl
description: A pearl with a black glow.\nFetches a high price.

name: Sunstone
description: An ore that glows dimly in\nthe sun, found during the\nday. Has a variety of uses.

name: Stone
description: A small rock. Can be thrown.

name: Iron Ore
description: Ore that can be smelted\ninto metal and used for\nmany different purposes.

name: Earth Crystal
description: Crystallized microbes which\nare prized as an abrasive\nwhen forging weapons.

name: Machalite Ore
description: An ore that yields better\nmetals than Iron Ore. Used\nto make Machalite.

name: Dragonite Ore
description: A rare, valuable ore that\nyields metal superior to\nthat of Machalite.

name: Carbalite Ore
description: An ore that is still being\nresearched. It yields even\nbetter metal than Dragonite.

name: Fucium Ore
description: A mysterious ore capable of\nfusing nearly any materials\ntogether.

name: Firestone
description: A stone that combusts even\nat room temperature. Used\nto fuse materials together.

name: （ダミー）
description: ダミー。

name: Coal
description: A combustible rock that\nemits a faint warmth.\n~C05(Account Item)~C00

name: Lightcrystal
description: An extremely hard substance\nwith a faint glow. Sometimes\nused for crafting tools.

name: Novacrystal
description: A brightly glowing crystal.\nExtremely hard, it's also\nused to make armory tools.

name: Antiseptic Stone
description: Combining an Earth Crystal\nand insect nutrients creates\nthis. Not found in nature.

name: Ice Crystal
description: Ice that will not melt at\nroom temperature. Can be\nused to create denser ore.

name: （ダミー）
description: ダミー。

description: A large, beautifully colored\nflowering plant foreign to\nthis land.

name: Ale Nuts
description: Oily nuts often used in \nofficial Guild beverages.\nThey can stain the skin.

name: Anbar Ore
description: Strange amber-colored ice\noften found full of trapped\ninsects and plants.

name: Secret Stash
description: A pouch carried by a Melynx.\nFull of miscellaneous junk.\n~C05(Account Item)~C00

name: Sushifish
description: A delicious, fatty fish.\nEating it recovers a small\namount of Health.

name: Sleepyfish
description: A fish containing sleeping\nagents.

name: Pin Tuna
description: A fish with jaws covered in\ntiny, needle-like spikes.

name: Popfish
description: A fish that literally pops\nwhen it dies.

name: Scatterfish
description: A fish that splits into\nlittle pieces when it dies.

name: Burst Arowana
description: A fish that bursts open when\nit dies.

name: Bomb Arowana
description: A fish that explodes when\nit dies.

name: Large Whetfish
description: An enormous Whetfish. Its\nsharp scales serve as even\nbetter Whetstones.

name: Large Sleepyfish
description: An enormous Sleepyfish.\nUsed to craft ammo.

name: Large Pin Tuna
description: An enormous Pin Tuna.\nUsed to craft ammo.

name: Large Popfish
description: An enormous Popfish.\nUsed to craft ammo.

name: Large Arowana
description: An enormous Burst Arowana.\nUsed to craft ammo.

name: Glutton Tuna
description: A fish that eats anything --\nallowing you to sometimes\nget items from its stomach.

name: Gastronome Tuna
description: An enormous Glutton Tuna.\nWill eat anything, no matter\nthe size.

name: Goldenfish
description: A rare fish made of solid\ngold. Sell it for a tidy\nsum. ~C05(Account Item)~C00

name: Speartuna
description: A giant fish that's both\nrare and valuable. Maybe it\ncould be used for something?

name: Small Goldenfish
description: A small, rare, gold fish.\nCommands a high price.

name: Platinumfish
description: A rare fish made of solid\nplatinum. Sell it for a tidy\nsum.

name: Ancient Fish
description: A rare catch prized for its\nevery part. Whispers say it\nmight even make a fine meal.

name: Queen Shrimp
description: A shrimp that once ruled as\nqueen. Known to occasionally\ndevour its mate.

name: Insect Husk
description: The remains of a dead\ninsect.

name: Yambug
description: Named for its shape. Make\nfishing lures with it; its\nscent drives Tunas wild.

name: Bughopper
description: A roundish insect, whose\nscent drives Arowana wild.\nTry making lures with it.

name: Snakebee Larva
description: An unusual larva. Its scent\ndrives Goldenfish wild. Try\nmaking lures with it.

name: Godbug
description: An insect said to live for\na thousand years.

name: Bitterbug
description: A sharp-tasting bug with\ninnate healing abilities.\nEating it may cure Poison.

name: Flashbug
description: An insect that emits a\npowerful flash when it\ndies.

name: Thunderbug
description: An insect that emits\nelectricity when struck.\nHas many applications.

name: King Scarab
description: The royal class of the\nscarabs, with a hard shell\nand lustrous wings.

name: Glueglopper
description: A cricket-like bug that\ndisgorges an extremely\npowerful adhesive.

name: Rare Scarab

name: Gaoren Pincer
description: Giant pincer from a Shen\nGaoren. It can slice even\nmetal; deadly to hunters.

name: Rainbow Ore
description: This dreamlike ore can be\ncombined to produce many\ncolors and properties.

name: Springnight Carp
description: A species of carp whose\narrival signals the start\nof the breeding season.

name: Carpenterbug
description: Uses viscous fluids and\nsharp jaws to construct\nmarvelous ant hills.

name: Rainbow Scarab
description: A dreamlike insect that\nreveals many colors and\nproperties upon processing.

name: Great Hornfly
description: An insect with a giant horn,\nmassive shell, and wings of\nbutterfly-like beauty.

name: Great Ladybug
description: A giant insect with a very\nhard shell. Protects crops\nby eating harmful pests.

name: Shaka Treasure
description: A Shakalaka's treasure.\nAlthough to be honest, it\nlooks like a piece of trash.

name: ShakaInheritance
description: Dropped by King Shakalaka.\nIt's the King's splendid...\ngarbage?

name: Giaprey Scale
description: A Giaprey scale. The color\nallows you to stalk prey in\nthe snow undetected.

name: Giaprey Scale+
description: A high-quality scale carved\nfrom a Giaprey. Used to\ncraft even better equipment.

name: Giaprey Hide
description: Hide stripped of all its\nscales. Used to make\nclothing for villagers.

name: Giadrome Hide
description: The hide of a Giaprey\nleader. It bears the scars\nof a leadership role.

name: Giadrome Claw
description: A claw sharper than that of\na Giaprey. Highly dangerous\nto the touch.

name: Giadrome Claw+
description: The Giaprey pack leader's\nclaw. Countless prey have\nfallen to its keen edge.

name: Giadrome Head
description: A Giadrome head. The large\ncrest displays its control\nover the pack.

name: Sinister Cloth
description: Found long ago in the tomb\nof a king from a long\nforgotten desert land.

name: C2D Fragment
description: A stone with the power of\nan unknown civilization.\n~C05(Account Item)

name: Perennial Frost
description: Long-lasting frost formed on\na Daora Fossil. Prized as a\ncrafting material.

name: Kushalite
description: A fossilized Daora Scale.\nIt cools rapidly at night,\nproducing infusible frost.

name: Aminotite
description: A soft, clay-like stone.\nWorthless at a glance, but\nit is actually rare ore.

name: Slimy Mushroom
description: A mushroom so slimy that\nit's difficult to even\ngrasp.

name: Sticky Ctrpillar
description: A predatory bug. Squirts\nfoam that's impossible to\nscrape off.

name: Sniperfish
description: A predatory fish that hunts\nprey above the surface by\nsquirting water from sacs.

name: Kurenzite
description: An ore that forms the base\nof an abrasive used for all\nsorts of metals.

name: Furniture Ticket
description: A ticket awarded for taking\npart in the Decor Derby.\nTry collecting them!

name: Furniture Tkt G
description: A ticket awarded for taking\npart in the Grand Decor\nDerby. Try collecting them!

name: Shocking Extract
description: A Thunderbug concentrate\nthat releases an electrical\ndischarge when struck.

name: Chaos Mushroom
description: A mushroom that invites\ndisarray. Its spores cause\nmonsters to hallucinate.

name: Toxin Sac
description: A monster organ filled\nwith a potent toxin. Just\ntouching it is dangerous.

name: Inferno Sac
description: A monster organ filled with\npowder that ignites when\nexposed to air.

name: Thunder Sac
description: A monster organ that can\nstore up large amounts of\nhigh voltage electricity.

name: Monster Bone+
description: Top-quality monster bone.\nHard to find, but vital for\ncrafting tough equipment.

name: Brute Bone
description: The stout bone of a\nbrutish monster. An easy\nmaterial to work with.

name: Stoutbone
description: The large, sturdy bone of a\nbeast. Prized by blacksmiths\nas a prime forging material.

name: Felyne Fur Ruby
description: A priceless ruby formed\nby the rare hardening of\na Felyne hairball.

name: Bulldrome Tusk
description: A majestic Bulldrome Tusk.\nThe damaged surface tells\nthe tale of many battles.

name: HighQualityPelt
description: Feels wonderful to the\ntouch. Difficult to carve\nbut valued by the Guild.

name: Giaprey Hide+
description: High quality hide carved\nfrom a Giadrome. Often used\nto forge powerful armor.

name: Velociprey Hide+
description: The high-quality, descaled\nhide of a Velociprey, it\nhas many applications.

name: Genprey Hide+
description: The high-quality, descaled\nhide of a Genprey. It can\nneutralize neurotoxins.

name: Gendrome Tail
description: This flexible tail has\nadapted to the harsh\nconditions of the desert.

name: Ioprey Hide+
description: High-quality, descaled \nIoprey hide. The red skin\nresists poison.

name: Kut-Ku Scale+
description: A superior Kut-Ku scale. Its\nsize and weight make it look\nclassier than normal.

name: B.Kut-Ku Scale+
description: Superior scale from a Blue\nYian Kut-Ku. Its complex\ncolor is infinitely cool.

name: Blango Pelt
description: A snow white Blango Pelt.\nIt protects the body against\nthe mountain cold.

name: Blango Pelt+
description: Keeps you toasty in frigid\ntemps; harder to work with\nthan normal Blango Pelts.

name: Conga Pelt
description: Conga fur. Sturdy and nice\nto the touch.

name: Conga Pelt+
description: The hard pelt of a Conga.\nThe thick fur can be used to\nmake long-lasting equipment.

name: Plesioth Fin+
description: A radiant fin. Below the\nsurface lie sharp barbs\nwith a deadly neurotoxin.

name: G.Plesioth Scl+
description: A quality Green Plesioth\nscale. Its hue enthralls\nall who see it.

name: G.Plesioth Fin+
description: Quality Green Plesioth fin.\nFlexible, easy to process,\nand widely used in jewelry.

name: Rath Fluid
description: Heat-producing fluid from a\nRathian or Rathalos. Used to\ncraft equipment.

name: Rath Medulla
description: Recent advances allow this\nmarrow to be extracted. It\nignites on air contact.

name: Basarios Tears
description: Faintly pink gems found\nnear the tear ducts of a\nBasarios.

name: Gravios Medulla
description: This brain stem is a\nprecious but hard to\ncraft Gravios part.

name: B.Diablos Ridge+
description: A hard Black Diablos back-\nplate. Even hot desert winds\ncan't erode such sturdiness.

name: Hornetaur Cpc
description: The hard part of a Hornetaur\nshell. Exhibits special\nproperties when worked.

name: Lao-Shan Scale+
description: A dark red Lao-Shan scale.\nIts toughness rivals that\nof a flying wyvern shell.

name: Gaoren Carapace
description: Carved from Shen Gaoren.\nShaped by time, this shell\nis harder than even metal.

name: Gaoren Thoracic
description: A hard Shen Gaoren shell.\nIts strength makes the beast\na walking fortress.

name: Fire Dragon Wbng
description: Wing webbing carved from a\nfire dragon. A marvelous\nmaterial with many uses.

name: Dragonmoss+
description: The miraculous power of\nthis material can raise the\nquality of crafted goods.

name: Dragonwood+
description: Shining Dragonwood. Its\nbeauty can be transferred\nto equipment.

name: Tigrex Scale
description: Scale from the incredibly\nviolent Tigrex. Incredibly\nmassive and sturdy.

name: Tigrex Scale+
description: A flawless Tigrex scale.\nCan be fastened with others\nto become harder than steel.

name: Tigrex Shell
description: A hard Tigrex shell capable\nof repelling any impact.\nExtreme tenacity.

name: Tigrex Carapace
description: A material hardened by the\nsands of time. Sharp edges\nshow the Tigrex's ferocity.

name: Tigrex Tail
description: This flexible and strong\ntail can be used to forge\ngreat equipment.

name: Tigrex Claw
description: A vicious foreclaw unique\nto the Tigrex. Other flying\nwyverns do not have it.

name: Tigrex Claw+
description: A claw that time has\nsharpened into a horrible\ndeath sentence for prey.

name: Tigrex Fang
description: A terrifying fang used to\ncrush prey. Makes all who\nsee it quiver in fear.

name: Tigrex Fang+
description: The sharp fang of a Tigrex.\nThese fangs can cut any prey\nto shreds.

name: Tigrex Scalp
description: A part of the Tigrex's head.\nLooks terrifying, as if it\nis still alive.

name: Akantor Scale+
description: A splendid scale with a\nfaint glow. Requires cooling\nafter all that time in lava.

name: Akantor Carapace
description: Shining Akantor Shell.\nExceptionally hard, and thus\ndifficult to craft.

name: Akantor Tail
description: The large rock-like tail of\nan Akantor. Strong enough to\ngouge the earth.

name: Akantor Hardclaw
description: Hard Akantor claw that can\nsmash bedrock. Its victims\nare left unrecognizable.

name: Akantor Tallfang
description: Huge fang that can pierce\nthe heavens. It has passed\nthrough many foes.

name: Akantor Spike
description: A flawless spike from an\nAkantor. It can easily scar\nrock.

name: Hypno Pelt
description: The pelt of a Hypnocatrice.\nStrong, supple, and vivid\norange in hue.

name: Hypno Claw
description: A hard to break claw with a \ndull black luster. Used to\ndecorate equipment.

name: Rainbow Quill
description: An iridescent tail feather.\nWidely used as a decoration\nand beloved by young nobles.

name: Hypno Beak
description: An intricately shaped beak. \nIts unique form is beloved\nby certain hunters.

name: Hypno Bezoar
description: A stone swallowed to aid\ndigestion, now turned into\na clear, radiant crystal.

name: Hypno Pelt+
description: An outstandingly beautiful\nHypnocatrice pelt. Used as\na crafting material.

name: Hypno Beak+
description: A well-shaped beak that\nboasts fang-like sharpness\nand exceptional toughness.

name: Hypno Claw+
description: A quality claw carved from\na Hypnocatrice. Razor sharp,\nhard, and lustrous.

name: Hypno Bezoar+
description: A pure, beautifully shaped\nbezoar. A treasure coveted\nby noble ladies.

name: Blue Hypno Pelt
description: Vibrant blue feathers grown\nto attract a mate. Found on\nVivid Hypnocatrice.

name: Blue Hypno Pelt+
description: A top-quality pelt carved\nfrom a Vivid Hypnocatrice.\nPerfect for crafting gear.

name: Lavasioth Scale
description: A golden Lavasioth scale.\nCapable of withstanding\nboiling hot lava.

name: Lavasioth Shell
description: A carapace encrusted with\nhardened minerals, making\nfor excellent armor.

name: Lavasioth Fang
description: The fang of a Lavasioth.\nStrong enough to crush\ncrustaceans with ease.

name: Lavasioth Fin
description: A fin with a naturally\nrazor sharp edge. Prized\nas a weapon material.

name: Lavasioth Scale+
description: A superior Lavasioth scale.\nThe encrusted lava leaves\nbehind a gold sheen.

name: Lavasioth Cpc
description: A shell encrusted with rare,\nhardened ore. Even wyverns\nstruggle to scratch it.

name: Lavasioth Fang+
description: A sharp Lavasioth fang.\nIts size is unusual for a \npiscine wyvern.

name: Lavasioth Fin+
description: A quality fin sharpened into\na virtual weapon due to the\nlava's heat.

name: Accord Ticket
description: A ticket given to hunters\nbound by an unbreakable\nfriendship.

name: Bronze N Medal
description: A bronze medal made of rare\nore. Inscribed with a "N"-\nshaped mark.

name: Silver N Medal
description:
A silver medal made of rare
ore. Inscribed with a "N"-
shaped mark.

name: Gold N Medal
description:
A gold medal made of rare
ore. Inscribed with a "N"-
shaped mark.

name: Neodymium Note
description: A fragment of a long lost\ncrafting tome, known only\nby the name "Neodymium".

name: Mercury Note
description: A fragment of a long lost\ncrafting tome, known only\nby the name "Mercury".

name: Clan Ticket
description: A ticket used as currency\nin the Clan Hall. Mainly\nobtained from Clan Quests.

name: BlackMarketCoin
description: A coin sold sold at a fixed\nprice on the black market.\nAlso known as "The Goods".

name: RuggedWhtFabric
description: 肌触りも良く、吸収性も高い\n白い布地。ジャンルを問わず、\nいろいろな服に利用が可能。

name: Costume Parts
description: 服と相性の良いアクセサリー\nを作るのに必要な素材。軽く\nてキレイな仕上がりになる。

name: Striped Fabric

description: A bag received on New Year's\nEve. Filled with something,\nbut definitely not zenny.

name: Raviente Blood
description: Blood with a thick, syrupy\ntexture. Highly coveted as\na research material.

name: Raviente Ruby
description: A Raviente ruby. Its sheer\nsize is a sight to behold.

name: Raviente Hide
description: The hide of a Raviente.\nDespite its thinness, it\nis surprisingly tough.

name: Raviente Scale
description: A Raviente scale that grows\nstronger with use. Beloved\nby hunters.

name: Raviente Wing
description: Though shaped like a fin,\nits sheer size makes it a\nwing.

name: Raviente Marrow
description: A hard-to-extract marrow\nhidden beneath a layer of\nextremely thick bones.

name: Raviente Horn
description: The horn of a Raviente.\nIts immense gravitas defies\ndescription.

name: Raviente Fang
description: A Raviente fang. Equal in\nsize to a horn and tougher\nthan most known ores.

name: Raviente Tail
description:
A Raviente tail. As heavy
as lead, but exceptionally
flexible.

name: Raviente Spike
description: The spike of a Raviente.\nA giant rugged mass that is\nundeserving of its name.

name: Power Gem
description: A large crystal imbued with\nintense heat. The potential\nit offers is limitless.

name: Power Gem+
description: A flawless crystal imbued\nwith a power even greater\nthan that of a Power Gem.

name: Rare Power Gem
description: A wondrous crystal known as\nthe "King of Power Gems".\nPriceless.

name: Dandelion Leaf
description: A bone-hard, yet easy to\nprocess leaf. Prized for\nits rarity.

name: Subherb
description: A versatile plant commonly\nused a substitute for rare\nmaterials during processing.

name: Wht Speckshroom
description: A mushroom named after the\nsmall white spots found on\nits surface.

name: Rattleberry
description: A berry that, once dried,\nmakes a lovely, crisp sound\nwhen shaken.

name: Rustleweed
description: A plant named for the\nrustling sound it makes\nwhen swaying in the wind.

name: Blk Speckshroom
description: A mushroom named after the\nsmall black spots found on\nits surface.

name: Gemerald
description: A crystal clear, green\nmineral. Extremely rare,\nand therefore valuable.

name: Striped Quartz
description: A mineral characterized by\nits striped pattern. No one\ncould hope to replicate it.

name: Beast Fossil
description: A fossilized horn fragment\nfrom an ancient monster.\nExtremely tough.

name: Pink Crystal
description: A heatproof, shock-resistant\ncrystal. Pure specimens sell\nfor a hefty sum.

name: Shroomstone
description: A mineral shaped entirely\nby nature -- and somehow\nunmistakably mushroom-like.

name: Boardstone
description: A thin, flat mineral. Its\nsides are sturdy, but the\ntop and bottom are not.

name: Wealthbug
description: An insect sometimes treated\nas a money charm due to its\ngolden shell.

name: Branchbug
description: A slow-moving insect that\nlooks just like a tree\nbranch.

name: Velocibutterfly
description: A butterfly named for the\nVelociprey-like pattern on\nits wings.

name: Red Buttonbug
description: An insect named for its\nround shape and glossy\nred wings.

name: Green Butterfly
description: A butterfly named after the\ngreen eye-like pattern found\non its wings.

name: Leafworm
description: An insect whose color and\nback closely resemble a\nleaf.

name: Shaka Loincloth
description: A leaf worn by Shakalaka\naround the waist. Wait,\ndoes this mean...

name: Smooth Stone
description: A stone processed to have a\nspherical surface. Coarse,\nbut well-rounded.

name: Bent Lumber
description: An artificially curved piece\nof wood. Used when a sturdy\nmaterial is required.

name: Soiled Rag
description: A well-used scrap of cloth\nthat scarcely retains its\noriginal shape -- or color.

name: Broken Knife
description: A sliver of metal at the end\nof the handle is all that\ndistinguishes it as a knife.

name: Thin Board
description: Made by thinly slicing a\ntree vertically. Sturdy if\nlayered with one another.

name: Delicate Flower
description: A precious flower that only\nblooms one a year -- if it\nblooms at all.

name: Thirstberry
description: A berry that grows without\nmuch water. Eating it makes\nyou really thirsty.

name: Nectarless Herb
description: A plant that lures insects\nwith a sweet, nectar-like\naroma, and eats them.

name: Humble Herb
description: Not very tasty or suitable\nfor crafting, but still\nworth gathering if you can.

name: Demon Cactus
description: A cactus with distinctively\nvivid flowers that stay in\nbloom for over a month.

name: Goldberry Flower
description: Unlike the juicy fruit it\nproduces, this plant's\nflowers are bright blue.

name: Adamond
description: A crystal clear, tough\nmineral. Extremely rare,\nand therefore valuable.

name: Litemacha Ore
description: Makes for a versatile\nmaterial when refined.\nMade mainly of crystals.

name: Litecarba Ore
description: Makes for a versatile\nmaterial when refined.\nMade mainly of metal.

name: Roundstone
description: The forces of nature have\nsmoothed its edges, making\nit appear rounded.

name: Rhinestone
description: The forces of nature have\nsmoothed its edges, making\nit look diamond-shaped.

name: Pentastone
description: The forces of nature have\nsmoothed its edges, making\nit look star-shaped.

name: Stag Beetle
description: An insect with impressive\npincers and horns. Be sure\nto approach it from behind.

name: Nailhopper
description: Long, thin, and covered in\na hard shell, this bug could\neasily be used as a nail.

name: Luminescent Worm

name: Insect Exuvia

name: Snowflake Herb
description: A plant with white flowers\nthat bloom like snowflakes\npiled upon green leaves.

name: Sleet Herb
description: A plant named for the way\nits nectar drops from its\nflowers, resembling sleet.

name: Popo Lily
description: A plant named for its large\nwhite flowers, reminiscent\nof a Popo's tusks.

name: Slipperwort
description: The leaves that surround the\nfruits of this plant look\njust like a woman's purse.

name: Flipped Herb
description: A plant with leaves that\nappear reversed, almost as\nif turned inside out.

name: Parnet
description: A crystal clear, orange\nmineral. Extremely rare,\nand therefore valuable.

name: Green Moldstone
description: At first glance, this weird\nmineral seems to be covered\nwith green mold.

name: Blue Moldstone
description: At first glance, this weird\nmineral seems to be covered\nwith blue mold.

name: Red Moldstone
description: At first glance, this weird\nmineral seems to be covered\nwith red mold.

name: Snowball Jewel
description: A lump of white crystal with\na radial pattern. Looks just\nlike a snowball.

name: Icebug
description: An insect that can live in\nthe coldest places, but\ncan't handle water at all.

name: Giaprey Monarch
description: A butterfly named for the\nGiaprey-like pattern on\nits wings.

name: White Centipede
description: A white centipede with legs\nand feelers that are longer\nthan its body. Pretty swift.

name: Snow Spider
description: A large spider known for\nits soft hair, reminiscent\nof fresh snow.

name: Slumberbug
description: An insect that lives under-\nground and survives only a\nfew days above it.

name: Ragged Pouch
description: A pouch that looks like it's\nbeen chewed up by a monster.\nMade of a good material.

name: Withered Bouquet
description: This bunch of flowers has\nseen much better days, but\nis full of rare specimens.

name: Cracked Pot
description: Many attempts have been\nmade to fix this pot, but\nit remains cracked...

name: Pepperberry
description: The go-to ingredient for\nspice lovers. Not for the\nfaint of heart.

name: Hellfiery Herb
description: A plant named for its large,\nflame-shaped leaves. Despite\nthis, it's not hot at all.

name: Coalgrass
description: A herb that looks like\nburnt-out coal, but actually\ncontains a lot of water.

name: Fiery Herb
description: A plant named for its flame\n-shaped leaves. In spite of\nthis, it's not hot at all.

name: Toasty Bean
description: A strange bean that feels\nas if it had been cooked,\neven when raw.

name: Truby
description: A crystal clear red mineral.\nExtremely rare and therefore\nvaluable.

name: RedBurdockStone
description: A red stone with trace\namounts of metal. Shaped\nlike a cut burdock root.

name: Combustone
description: A rock that combusts when\ncrushed. Dangerous, and\ntherefore hard to come by.

name: BlkBurdockStone
description: A black stone with trace\namounts of metal. Shaped\nlike a cut burdock root.

name: BluBurdockStone
description: A blue stone with trace\namounts of metal. Shaped\nlike a cut burdock root.

name: Swelterbug
description: An insect named after its\nability to withstand extreme\nheat, such as that of lava.

name: Ioprey Monarch
description: A butterfly named for the\nIoprey-like pattern on\nits wings.

name: Basaltbug
description: An insect named for its\nlava rock-like body.

name: Blue Butterfly
description: A butterfly named after the\nblue eye-like pattern found\non its wings.

name: Sm. Sword Handle
description: This sword handle looks far\ntoo small for a human, and\nappears to be well-used.

name: Burnt Felvine
description: Though charred, this plant\nhas somehow retained its\noriginal shape.

name: Unfinished Barrel
description: An unfinished, palm-sized\nbarrel. Strands of fur can\nbe seen between its gaps.

name: Stone Crown
description: A piece of stone tablet with\nan image on it that's been\ncut off at the bottom.

name: Stone Panel
description: A piece of stone tablet with\nan image on it that's cut\noff at the top and bottom.

name: Stone Base
description: A piece of stone tablet with\nan image on it that's been\ncut off at the top.

name: Stone Plate
description:
A reassembled stone tablet.
Very rare, and therefore
highly valuable.

name: Draguros Cpc
description: A sturdy Draguros shell.\nCharacterized by its snow\nwhite hue.

name: Draguros Scale+
description: A fine Draguros shell. Used\nas a crafting material for\nheat-retentive armor.

name: Draguros Tail+
description: A Draguros tail. Extremely\ndurable, albeit smaller than\nthose of other wyverns.

name: Draguros Claw+
description: One of the two weapons used\nby the Draguros. No prey can\nescape its grasp.

name: Draguros Horn+
description: A horn thought to control\nthe Draguros's dark thunder.\nNot used as a weapon.

name: Draguros Wing+
description: When left unattended, these\nwings accumulate charge and\nemit static electricity.

name: Draguros Marrow
description: A rare bone marrow that\nenables the Draguros's\nsupple movements.

name: Draguros Mane
description: A rare, fragile Draguros\nmane. Requires skillful\nhandling.

name: Draguros Leadgem
description: A crystal thought to form\nduring energy compression\ninside the body.

name: Draguros Cert.
description: A certificate given only to\nthose who've triumphed over\nthe most arduous of hunts.

description: 教官見習ネコの熱い心意気。\n持ち歩くと教官見習ネコの\n言葉を思い出す。

description: 極めて純度の高い堅い鋼石。\n加工が困難のため、一部の武\n具職人しか取り扱っていない。

name: Ultrahard Blade
description: 複合素材で補強された大剣の\n刃。その硬さと斬れ味は申し\n分ない。

name: HG Felyne File
description: なにやら不思議な形をした\n錆び磨きのためのヤスリ。\n作り方は秘密らしい。

name: Art of Fishing
description: 釣りを極めた達人が書いた\n一子相伝の秘法が記載された\n極めて貴重な書物。

name: Black Beast Fang
description: 黒き獣から入手できる白い牙。\nその鋭さは見る者を脅えさせ、\n触れる者をシビレさせる。

name: Lavastone
description: 溶岩の中から稀に採れる\n真珠のような赤い宝石。\n高温を自力で発せられる。

name: Tiny Hammer
description: A golden hammer clutched by\nthe small beast. Capable of\nshattering any horn.

name: Iron Compass
description: 普通の方位磁針ではなく、\nある地点を探すための道具\nらしい。

name: Black Fur
description: モコモコしているけがわ。\nその表面をさわると、抗うこ\nとができない眠気に襲われる。

name: Shocking Talon
description: 鋭利に尖っている爪。\nその斬れ味もさることながら、\n触れるとビリっと感電する。

name: Nar Stone
description: 常に炎が迸っている石。\nその熱の高さ故に、この鉱石\nを運ぶ方法が存在しない。

name: Shivering Beak
description: 常に震えている不思議なクチ\nバシ。頑強な素材と組み合わ\nせることで、震えは止まる。

name: Gyre Cucumber
